title: OS Goes Crazy

Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe

summary: Stu Doran played a two-player event at a place he calls 'OS', reported in October 2001, with WYS and Hunt Down against Podracing Profit and Watto decks; the report gives no results.
notes: Previously skipped (no results, date or place); published per Bill 2026-10-25.

Very short report: only the decks of the two players are given ('his' decks: LS PODPROFIT, DS WATTO; the opponent is presumably 'Brad', thanked for 'putting on a show'). No games, results, date or place are stated, so games is empty.

Event name derived: no date or known place ('OS' is not explained) and no other reports by the author to give a home city, so named from the posting month (posted 4 October 2001): 'October 2001 tournament (Stu Doran)'. event_date '2001-10' is the posting month, not stated in the report.
Format Premiere - Coruscant assumed from the posting date (Watto deck = Coruscant's No Money, No Parts, No Deal! objective, legal from August 2001); not stated in the report.

Objectives: 'WYS' = Watch Your Step; 'HUNTDOWN' = Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi. The opponent's PodProfit (You Can Either Profit By This...) and Watto (No Money, No Parts, No Deal!) are not entered as games because no game is described.
Byline Stu "Disco Stu" Doran: credited as Stu Doran (new page); no Stu/Stuart Doran page exists.
